NOTE: THIS IS A REQUEST, NOT A DECISION. It is unsigned. Its decision field is not ADMIT and its provenance names no principal, so it cannot be used as an admission. Note what does and does not provide that guarantee: the identity string is NOT the boundary -- it selects which public key in allowed_signers must have signed. The boundary is possession of the private signing key, which is held off-host and must never exist on the research host, together with protection of the allowed_signers file itself. Only the admission authority may author and sign the decision.
